prerequisites: Participation in "Grundlagen Werkstoffwissenschaft" (GWW) (Fundamentals of Materials Science) is desirable.

learning_outcomes.text: Describe the production of steel and associated fundamental melt metallurgical aspects.
Interpret the chemical compositions of steels.
Explain the microstructures of the treated steels.
Name essential material properties and differences of the treated steels and the resulting fields of application.
Make a rough material selection for practical use, considering mechanical and/or corrosive stress.
Work independently in the field of steels.
Take responsibility for the services provided.
Work on and solve tasks related to steels, even in teams.
Act fairly and cooperatively and deal appropriately with conflicts.
Actively contribute to the development of topics in the field of steels.

syllabus_topics: Quenched and tempered, case-hardened and nitriding steels
Independent knowledge acquisition on a specific topic or strengthening research competence
Familiarization with new topics and critical questioning
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded for a successfully passed written exam (grade). Successful participation in the accompanying internship is a prerequisite for taking the exam.
